name: Navigation Menu
description: Provides a configurable navigation menu with routing support
author: Framework Team

showIcons.title: Show Icons
showIcons.description: Whether to display icons in menu items

theme.title: Menu Theme
theme.description: Visual theme for the navigation menu

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of menu items to display

menuBgColor.title: Menu Background Color
menuBgColor.description: Background color of the navigation menu.

menuTextColor.title: Menu Text Color
menuTextColor.description: Text color for navigation menu items.

menuActiveColor.title: Active Menu Item Color
menuActiveColor.description: Color for the active menu item.

menuHoverColor.title: Menu Hover Color
menuHoverColor.description: Background color on menu item hover.

menuIconSize.title: Menu Icon Size
menuIconSize.description: Size of menu icons in px.

menuAnimation.title: Menu Animation
menuAnimation.description: Enable open/close animation for the menu.

menuSticky.title: Sticky Menu
menuSticky.description: Make the menu sticky/fixed on scroll.

hideOnMobile.title: Hide on Mobile
hideOnMobile.description: Hide the menu on mobile devices.

responsiveBreakpoint.title: Responsive Breakpoint
responsiveBreakpoint.description: Screen width (px) at which the menu collapses/hides.
